changes: Added the M0-M2 playbook outcome ledger foundation: new PlaybookOutcomeEvent schema, append/read validation helpers, host-neutral playbook_outcome_record command, command policy/process-fact registration, and smoke coverage for explicit exposure semantics.
usage: Use lattice playbook_outcome_record with storyId, playbookId, exposureMode, consumer, context, and outcome to append an audit-only outcome row under .lattice/learning/playbook-outcomes.jsonl. The command is host-neutral and never creates gate evidence or activates a playbook.
expectedOutcome: Users can explicitly record candidate/active playbook observations while preserving Proofbound boundaries: candidates do not become active automatically, DONE completion alone does not count as helped, helped requires concrete exposure, and neutral/unknown outcomes remain observability-only.
actualTranscript: lattice validate passed 31 configured commands; done_required_validate passed packages/main build and root npm test. live_smoke_transcript captured focused output: playbook_outcome_record explicitly appends a non-authoritative ledger row PASS; ordinary story/DONE completion alone is not recorded as helped PASS; helped requires concrete exposure and structured verdict source PASS; no Codex/Claude-specific namespace introduced PASS. It also reported baseline_failure_confirmed=decision-doc-promotion-smoke.js:346 for the pre-existing main baseline failure in the broader playbook smoke.
outcomeDiff: Expected and actual match for B-dddd: explicit outcome recording exists, implicit DONE-to-helped settlement is rejected, exposure/source requirements are enforced, and no host-specific namespace was added. The known decision-doc-promotion baseline failure is outside this story and does not affect the new outcome checks.
limitations: V1 closes the assessment-ledger foundation only. It does not implement automatic candidate activation, promotion sweep evaluation, DONE settlement hooks, trial traffic, timers, runtime memory candidate surfacing, or non-deducible source registry enforcement; those remain later milestones in the execution plan.
pitfalls: Same-worktree owner lease switched session ids during TEST, so several metadata commands required explicit forceTakeover. The broader experience-layer playbook smoke still has a pre-existing decision-doc-promotion baseline failure on main; rely on focused outcome PASS lines for this story.
